idea: Exploit high-bandwidth RAM across many Cloudflare Edge Workers: explode a dataset too large for one machine into per-worker memory, run SIMD/MIMD-style anomaly detection and incremental training across workers, and persist only the deltas -- so a model can be trained on data that would not fit in one machine's memory. Target: live in 30 days.
customer: ML/infrastructure engineers who need to train a model on a dataset too large for any single machine's memory, and need a working distributed setup live within 30 days without provisioning new hardware.
pieces: not decomposed -- no independent Slicer has acted on this idea. See foundry/README.md, 'Slicer honesty correction.'
